title: ESS-MAI Executable Prior Art by Bledar Gjata — POC 003 and POC 004
description: A public Apache-2.0 collection of two surgically bounded ESS-MAI proof-of-concept capsules. POC 003 reproduces the generation-zero Shadow cold-start reachability gap and a positive causal control. POC 004 reproduces supported local GCL LAW-0 behavior together with counterexamples to stronger global continuity. Experimental success and experimental failure are preserved together as an architecture-preserving advancement method. The full ESS-MAI v1.8.9 core is not included.
